title: YAML status comment skips the required Worth section
detail: The real Spacedock reader reports status ideation for status: ideation # ready for review; the candidate reports stage unknown and exits 0 on a PRFAQ with no Worth questions. Control with plain status exits 1. AC-9.
fix: Read the status with the producer-compatible YAML semantics and retain the missing-section refusal.

title: An HTML comment counts as the required Worth section
detail: A missing Worth questions section exits 1; inserting only <!--\n### Worth questions\n--> makes the exact candidate exit 0. The rendered design still contains no such section. AC-9.
fix: Ignore HTML comments when determining whether the required design section exists.
